name: ExMORTALIS
detailed_description:
ExMORTALIS is a chilling First-Person Immersive Sim set in the remote Argentine town of Las Tormentas in 1893. Ascend El Dedo del Diablo, a 12-story Gothic laboratory tower where the Necrotechs—brilliant scientists obsessed with conquering death—conduct horrifying experiments in consciousness transfer and biological enhancement.

EXPLORE

  • Navigate interconnected floors designed for multiple solutions—stealth, combat, environmental manipulation, or mutation abilities.

  • Uncover the dark history of scientific progress through environmental storytelling and authentic 1890s research documents.

CHOOSE

  • Face voluntary mutation chambers that offer powerful abilities at the cost of your humanity.

  • Every biological modification changes how NPCs react to you and how you interact with the world.

  • Enhanced hearing makes machinery painful. Night vision brings light sensitivity. Power demands sacrifice.

SURVIVE

  • You remain vulnerable throughout—never becoming an invincible superhero, only more capable and less human.

  • Master the tower's systems and dangers through understanding, not grinding stats.

  • Period-appropriate weapons like the revolutionary C93 Borchardt pistol and Winchester Model 1893 shotgun.

DISCOVER

  • Experience Gothic horror grounded in real science—consciousness transfer, eugenics, and biological experimentation using legitimate 1890s medical knowledge.

  • Your choices determine not just survival, but what kind of human (if any) emerges from the tower.

The question isn't whether you can survive the Necrotechs' experiments—it's whether you'll still be human when you reach the top.

short_description: Awaken in the town of Las Tormentas, Argentina, 1893. Ascend El Dedo del Diablo, a laboratory tower where scientists conduct horrifying experiments. ExMORTALIS is a First-Person Immersive Sim inspired by System Shock and Prey. Choose mutations. Face consequences. Or not?
